_about: Hand translations for messages of scene slot 0x9F000 (JUNKER HQ, first visit) that have no Sega CD counterpart. Key = text offset in the slot.

entries.0x2a9f: Let's see... Judgement Uninfected Naked Kind & Execute Ranger...?
entries.0x2b1e: Judgement Uninfected Naked Kind & Execute Ranger...
entries.0x2f8c: It's fine to take an interest in Mika, but there are limits. Control yourself.
entries.0x2fc5: Seed, you don't seem to understand. Your love life is your own business, but watch your behavior inside headquarters.
entries.0x318b: A picture of a vase. What a weird pattern...
entries.0x3200: Suspecting people is part of this job, but aren't you overdoing it?
entries.0x32b9: Don't touch that picture! It's my treasure.
entries.0x33f9: That's right. Whatever the reason... hurting people is never allowed.
entries.0x3523: Would you like to hear about your duties once more? Or... do you have another question?
entries.0x35bd: That Harry doesn't seem to be around, though?
entries.0x3645: As you can see, she's a beautiful and intelligent woman. ...A bit strong-willed, though.
entries.0x3747: It's the nickname of the A.I. in the computer room. It manages all the systems and information of this headquarters.
entries.0x387d: Exactly. Even if it's only training...
entries.0x3a1c: ...So you were keeping an eye on me after all?
entries.0x3a31: Try to calm down a little.
entries.0x3a43: Hm. ...Snatchers suddenly appeared in this Neo Kobe City three years ago.
entries.0x3a73: Snatchers suddenly appeared in this Neo Kobe City three years ago.
entries.0x3b11: JUNKER was set up inside police headquarters one year ago as a special anti-Snatcher section.
entries.0x3b7c: Still... that poster is in bad taste.
entries.0x3ebd: From what Mika tells me, you bought the Pilot Disk?
entries.0x3ee2: Uh... yes, that's what I said.
entries.0x3ef5: For someone who did, you sure ask a lot. Well, I won't press the matter.
entries.0x41ca: A her-mit-crab, eh? ...Heh, that's a good one.
entries.0x4fcb: ...is what I'd like to say, but you got good reviews on the Pilot Disk, so...
entries.0x5005: It's a special commemorative disc released ahead of the main game. Did you buy it, Gillian?
entries.0x5031: You've had enough training. You already trained on the Pilot Disk, didn't you?
entries.0x5054: You'll be fine. You trained on the Pilot Disk, didn't you?
entries.0x5318: And you waste a lot of shots... Waste fewer shots and make sure of your target, okay?
entries.0x5369: After that, it's about telling citizens from Snatchers, right?
entries.0x5d3f: ...Thank you, Gillian. I'll take that as a compliment.
entries.0x5d9d: Those files look heavy, so I thought I'd carry them for you...
entries.0x5ecf: ...Maybe the Chief is right about you?
entries.0x5f07: Harry Benson is JUNKER's mechanic. He likes his drink a little, but he's a kind, old-fashioned man. Everybody calls him 'Pops'.
entries.0x5f5f: Harry is a genius who has won three Nobel Prizes and a Fields Medal.
entries.0x5fae: He seems to have... stepped out. He'll be back before long.
entries.0x6185: ...Maybe next time. If the chance comes up...
entries.0x61a5: I'll leave that to your imagination.
entries.0x61b5: Oh, Gillian! ...But no! I'm not telling. Why don't you look it up yourself?
entries.0x6206: I'm the serious type. But why?
entries.0x6247: Your three sizes: an unsolved case?
entries.0x629a: ...The Chief will get mad at you again, you know?
entries.0x62fb: That's your JUNKER ID. Take good care of it, okay?
entries.0x6318: You shouldn't go showing it around in public too much...
entries.0x6337: It's expense money, so you can use it when the investigation calls for it.
